summary: A large network of dental and dermatology clinics is a strength, but a proof section showing zeros and dead booking links appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The stats appear to read Clinics 0, Smiles veneers annually 0 and Our clients over 25 years 0, while the text cites 7 clinics in Al-Malaz and 11 in Al Olaya.
findings.cost: A proof section showing zeros makes a large group look empty.

findings.problem: The About Us, Services and Appointment menu items appear to link to #, and the hero buttons Who we are and Our Services appear to go to the same page.
findings.cost: Patients who tap Appointment or Services reach nothing.
findings.fix: Working menu and a booking form.

findings.problem: Copy appears to include 'Kadoon Clincis', 'Kadon Al Malaz Branch' and the unfinished 'as easy as is', and the Malaz branch heading shows an Al Rabwa address.
findings.cost: Typos and mismatched branches weaken a medical brand.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and correct branch pages.

findings.problem: The page appears to show no doctor names, reviews or WhatsApp, only a phone number, and all three Recent Videos link to blog-post-image.html.
findings.cost: No proof, no quick channel and placeholder links lose bookings.
findings.fix: Named doctors, reviews, WhatsApp and real videos.

redesign: Working menu, booking form and WhatsApp.
Proofread copy and correct branch pages.
